steps.note: Start an eRFX create flow for the RFQ.
Provide the required event title, which the invitations should contain.
Configure the event as an RFQ.
Apply the first available RFQ template.
Add the required RFQ line item.
Set and commit a close time for the invitation content.
Invite exactly two QA test vendors, corresponding to Vendors A and B.
Publish the RFQ and trigger vendor invitations.
Assert that the RFQ was successfully published before checking notifications.
